route.html: Return — two bookings, same evening. The three sons fly MEX→Madrid→Vienna on Iberia (ZVDHND, dep 19:00); Oliver & Alexandra fly MEX→Frankfurt→Vienna on Lufthansa/Austrian (72PPSU, dep 19:50). Both land Vienna Sat 22 Aug.

open.nights: 1 night · 10→11 Aug · 20 min to CUN airport
1 night · 17→18 Aug · lands MEX 14:00, Polanco starts 18 Aug

open.html: Cars: Cancún round-trip (7→11 Aug) and Oaxaca (11→17 Aug) are booked. No CDMX car — decided against it, so Teotihuacán on Wed 20 needs a tour or a driver.

Mérida: confirm arrival time with El Palacito Secreto (WhatsApp +52 999 224 4533) — payment is taken through the hotel's own system before arrival, so watch for a card-decline message. Price still unknown — the Booking confirmation went to Alexandra's inbox only.

Guest counts: Kobaab, Grana and Casa Badú are all on file for fewer than 5 adults. Hosts have agreed the extra person verbally in each case, but it isn't in the reservations and the extra beds aren't priced. Worth getting in writing before arrival.

Stay cost so far: Tulum €191 · Oaxaca €1,725 · Puerto Escondido €989 · CDMX €590 = ~€3,495 for 10 nights (ECB rates 27 Jul: EUR/USD 1.1389, EUR/MXN 19.8817). Mérida and the two open nights not included. Tickets: Casa Azul €43 + Lucha Libre €138.

Update 27 Jul: Mérida booked (El Palacito Secreto, conf 5960376510). NY address + door codes added. Casa Badú 5th bed confirmed. Prices added in EUR. CDMX rental car dropped. Casa Azul + Lucha Libre tickets logged. Correction: Polanco runs 18→21 Aug, not 17→21 — the night of 17 Aug is uncovered.

Route changes 18 Jul: Chichén overnight, Campeche and Puebla dropped. Yucatán loop: Tulum → Mérida 2 nights (via Cobá, cenotes & Valladolid, Uxmal day trip) → Puerto Morelos (via Chichén Itzá) → CUN. Palenque was dropped earlier for the round-trip loop.
